## About
Sugar Mill Chiropractic and Acupuncture sits on Sugar Creek Center Boulevard in Sugar Land. Look for the buildings with green roofs; we are in the back left building.
Chiropractic care is about learning, understanding and taking care of your body to improve your quality of life. Whether you come in with acute pain, chronic pain or a specialized pain syndrome, our doctors and staff use safe and natural procedures and take the time to explain what comes next.
Dr. Linda, Dr. Tara and Dr. Stacy see patients alongside our front desk team, including Miss Pam at reception. Patients have rated us 4.8 from 69 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Chiropractic Care: Safe and natural procedures for acute pain, chronic pain and specialized pain syndromes.
- Prenatal Chiropractic Care: Chiropractic care for pregnant women.
- Pediatric Chiropractic Care: Chiropractic care for children and even infants.
- Sports Therapy: Care for athletes.
- Acupuncture
- Non-Surgical Decompression
- Alternative Therapies
- Appointments with our Massage Therapists: Book directly with one of our massage therapists: Penny Dalfrey, Theresa Soto or Cathy Hinchman.

## FAQ
Q: Who is chiropractic care for?
A: Everyone. We see adults, pregnant women, athletes, children and even infants.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Call the office, send us an e-mail, or schedule an appointment online.

Q: What if I need to cancel?
A: Please give us at least 24 hours notice so we can offer your appointment to another patient.

Q: When are you open on Saturdays?
A: Saturday hours are 8:30 am to 11 am, by appointment only. Weekdays we are open 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM.

Q: How do I find the office?
A: Turn onto Sugar Creek Center Boulevard and look for three buildings with green roofs. We are in the back left building.
